DOC-001.title: Efficiency and Reaction Speed in Automated Financial Systems
DOC-001.text: Automated financial trading systems execute trades in microseconds, preventing large losses during sudden market crashes that humans cannot process in time.

DOC-002.title: Human Cognition and Decision-Making Latency under High Stress
DOC-002.text: Psychological studies show human decision-making latency increases by up to 300% under high stress, often leading to analysis paralysis or cognitive freezing.

DOC-003.title: Algorithmic Bias and Discrimination in Machine Learning Models
DOC-003.text: Data analyses demonstrate that machine learning models trained on historical data consistently propagate and amplify systemic racial and gender biases in lending and hiring.

DOC-004.title: Systemic Vulnerability and the Flash Crash of 2010
DOC-004.text: The 2010 Flash Crash was primarily triggered by high-frequency trading algorithms interacting in unforeseen feedback loops, wiping out a trillion dollars in minutes.

DOC-005.title: The Principle of Human Accountability in Safety-Critical Domains
DOC-005.text: Legal frameworks globally assert that moral and legal responsibility requires a human agent to remain 'in-the-loop' for all lethal or safety-critical decisions.

DOC-006.title: Scalability and Cost Reduction in Large-Scale Automated Logistics
DOC-006.text: Deploying autonomous decision-making agents across shipping logistics reduced operational costs by 35% and eliminated bottleneck delays caused by manual approval gates.

DOC-007.title: Security Vulnerabilities and Adversarial Attacks on Neural Networks
DOC-007.text: Deep neural networks remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbation attacks, where minor, imperceptible changes to inputs cause catastrophic classification errors.

DOC-008.title: Healthcare Diagnostic Accuracy of Convolutional Neural Networks
DOC-008.text: AI diagnostic models achieved a 94% accuracy rate in detecting skin cancers, matching or exceeding the performance of board-certified dermatologists.

DOC-009.title: Autonomous Weapons Systems and Ethical Compliance in Combat
DOC-009.text: Defense researchers argue that autonomous weapon systems lack the human capacity for empathy, mercy, and situational judgment required by the laws of war.

DOC-010.title: Industrial Grid Optimization and Carbon Footprint Reduction
DOC-010.text: AI agents managing smart electrical grids optimized power distribution in real-time, reducing grid-wide carbon emissions by 12% compared to human control.

DOC-011.title: Responsibility Deficits in Delegated Autonomous Decisions
DOC-011.text: Philosophical analyses highlight a 'responsibility gap' where neither the developer nor the user can be held ethically responsible for unforeseeable AI actions.

DOC-012.title: Error Rates and Hallucinations in Modern Generative Systems
DOC-012.text: Large language models continue to hallucinate factual assertions at rates between 3% and 15%, making unverified decisions highly risky for medical or legal applications.
